title: Track MonolixSuite Runs
text: mlxtrx launches Monolix, PKanalix Simulx runs keeps record one: ran, settings files, , . Every file fingerprinted SHA-256 hash, time can ask whether results disk still match files produced . Launch many models one call, grid (mono24, pk24, sim24) locally (monolix.sh, pkanalix.sh, simulx.sh). Detect whether run succeeded extract fit statistics. Get one condition per model, file folder: never run, failed, unfinished, inputs changed, output edited, clean. Check export settings MonolixSuite needs launching. Collect every run one data frame sort, filter export.

title: Track MonolixSuite Runs
text: Runs recorded store: folder plain JSON files, one folder per run. Point mlxtrx per session, usually project’s .Rprofile: Every function also takes store = directly. Without either, mlxtrx stops tells set . store created first run recorded.

title: Track MonolixSuite Runs
text: mono() pk() first check charts-data export settings tool’s config.ini (check_config_ini()). three record run submitted, wait grid jobs leave queue, record outputs statistics. default commands mono24, pk24 sim24; set options(mlxtrx.monolix_cmd = ), mlxtrx.pkanalix_cmd mlxtrx.simulx_cmd, pass cmd =, use another command local monolix.sh. Projects built edited lixoftConnectors: save saveProject(), run mono() pk().
code: library(mlxtrx)  run_ids <- mono(c("base/run1.mlxtran", "base/run2.mlxtran"), thread = 4) pk("nca/<study>_nca.pkx") sim("sim/<project>_sim.smlx")

title: Track MonolixSuite Runs
text: run_status() returns one row per model single condition, serious first: never_run, failed, unfinished, inputs_changed, output_edited, output_suspect, clean_late, clean. file run recorded untracked. Pass folder, project file, input output file. print_report_summary() prints result report. check_*() functions answer narrower questions project, input output files.
code: run_status("base") print_report_summary("base") #> === RUN STATUS REPORT === #> Path: /path/to/<project>/monolix/base #> ... #> Models: 3 #>   inputs_changed  1 #>   clean           2 #> #> Needs attention: #>   run2.mlxtran  inputs_changed #>     data/<study>_pk.csv modified

title: Track MonolixSuite Runs
text: runs_data() returns every recorded run one data frame, newest first: project, data model files, settings, command, software version, user, times state. Sort, filter export like data frame. Statistics include, Monolix, values summary.txt observation counts; PKanalix, tasks run, number individuals, compartmental analysis criteria bioequivalence ratios; Simulx, tasks run. get_run_files() lists every input output file run SHA-256 hash.
code: runs <- runs_data(include_summary = TRUE, latest_only = TRUE) write.csv(runs, "runs.csv", row.names = FALSE) get_run_files(runs$run_id[1])
